DACs have been the main component of CD players from day one. You know what they can sound like. What matters more is what the source of your music is. If you have a shitty recording that is all compressed and blown out then the DAC will faithfully reproduce the garbage you feed it. Even audiophile quality DACs can sound bad if you give them bad sound data. Cheap ones can sound good too if you feed them right. Standalone DACs aren't magic and they can't do much to fix a bad input source. They are nice to have for the options they bring to the table, but ultimately they aren't going to turn your system into something it isn't.
